kind: Measurement gap, not a verified site defect
finding: Dedicated Generative AI report and current indexed-view evidence could not be accessed.
recommended_action: Read authenticated GSC Generative AI Search report, record filters/date freshness and export pages/dates/countries/devices. Inspect priority exclusions through #747.
acceptance: First-party report or explicit no-data state saved; current Google-selected canonical and indexed verdict recorded for inspected URLs.
parent_benefit: Prioritises resources parents can actually discover.
seo_risk: None for observation. Do not add AI impressions to overall Search totals.

finding: Perplexity guest P01 requires sign-up; no usable answer or citations.
recommended_action: Complete the same 12 exact prompts in a supported authenticated native session when available. Retain NOT_TESTED until real results exist.
acceptance: 12 native answers or documented per-session blocks with screenshots and actual citations.
parent_benefit: Establishes whether Perplexity answers lead to relevant educational guidance.
seo_risk: No production change justified by missing access.

finding: AI Mode cited a Medium TinySteps republication instead of the intended site article.
recommended_action: Confirm control of the Medium account and inspect its canonical metadata/import settings plus the original-article attribution destination. Preserve the primary site owner. Change only a demonstrated syndication defect in a separately authorised task.
acceptance: Actual Medium canonical and original attribution recorded; no speculative site canonical or removal.
parent_benefit: Gives parents a reliable route to the maintained original and related guidance.
seo_risk: Blind canonical changes or deleting the syndicated copy could remove useful discovery.

finding: AI Mode selected the relevant error-family guide. Its relatedPaths do not point to the parent transfer article; the parent source has no direct contextual link to this guide.
recommended_action: After built/live link check, consider one natural parent-to-guide link at the correction routine and a return link where the guide discusses independent transfer. Keep both distinct intents and canonicals.
acceptance: At most two useful anchors, no duplicate card/inline handoff, no metadata/URL change, links present in built HTML.
parent_benefit: Connects why errors persist with worked examples and fresh-sentence practice.
seo_risk: Over-linking or conflating parent concern with a reference guide. No promised citation uplift.

finding: The comprehension article explains vocabulary/inference. An existing context-clues guide supplies worked evidence-based examples but is not linked within the article body.
recommended_action: After checking built/live overlays, consider one link from the vocabulary/inference discussion to the existing context-clues guide. Explicitly distinguish inferring word meaning from guessing printed words.
acceptance: One useful contextual anchor only if absent after rendering; no new guide, keyword variant or FAQ.
parent_benefit: Provides a practical next step for meaning gaps while preserving phonics decoding guidance.
seo_risk: Do not imply context should replace decoding or that this link causes AI selection.

kind: Native answer quality and monitoring gap, not a Tiny Steps content defect
affected_urls: P02/P03/P09/P12 expected owners and observed native answer URLs in EVALUATION_48.csv
finding: Native answers include overbroad neurological/clinical claims, false reassurance and poorly bounded home checks.
recommended_action: Keep Tiny Steps existing distinctions and professional-review boundaries. Include these errors in the next native quality check. Revise local content only if academic review demonstrates the same error locally.
acceptance: Named educational claims checked against primary sources; no clinical diagnosis, fixed guarantees or copying competitor claims.
parent_benefit: Protects accurate, impartial guidance and avoids unnecessary classes or delayed specialist advice.
seo_risk: Rewriting strong source guidance to imitate a selected but inaccurate answer would reduce quality.

affected_urls: All 85 governed guides, especially 27 without returned GSC rows
finding: 58/85 exact guide URLs returned rows. No returned row is not an index verdict. Definition queries show demand but do not establish a content defect.
recommended_action: Inspect indexing for the #747 overlap first, then review actual snippets/query intent for nouns, verbs and vocabulary definitions before any CTR experiment. Keep query/page totals separate.
acceptance: Verified index verdict where accessible; specific snippet/intent hypothesis and baseline before any title test.
parent_benefit: Protects existing useful guides and focuses improvements on demonstrated search needs.
seo_risk: Low CTR alone can trigger unnecessary title or content churn; missing rows must not be zero-filled.
